summary: Avoid stopped-loop faults when cancelling a run before any round starts

replay.detail: No projection replay or history rewrite. Stopped-loop items are derived from existing step states and linked round runs.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or claim fields change. The round-existence check uses the existing parent-step index.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and claim registry are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A cancelled loop with no child round no longer raises a stopped-loop fault, including cancellation while its run waits on after. Started-loop cancellations and all loop failures still raise their existing faults. Run cancellation and configured cancellation reports retain their behavior. No client or wire fields change.

downtime.detail: No migration or restart-specific work is needed.

manual.detail: The corrected derived fault visibility applies automatically to existing runs.

recovery.detail: Returning to the previous binary restores stopped-loop faults for unstarted cancellations. Historical cancellation claims remain unchanged.
